disposition_records.P02-BATCH-DEFAULT-ACCURACY: findNearestBatch gains a final cpuStrategy parameter, defaulting to .perQuery. The implicit Q>=8/N>=256 GEMM gate is deleted (duplicates scored 0.0146; near-duplicate top-10 collapsed). D1-D4 and API-41 go RED to GREEN. The provider gets the original batch before any CPU validation. RD3: enableMatrixRouting does not affect batch search (child-isolated test). The slowdown is disclosed in the CHANGELOG (one host: up to 22.6x at Q64/N4096 Euclidean; cosine at Q8 and all Q7 shapes faster).
disposition_records.P02-GRAM-EXPLICIT-BOUNDED: .gram is serial and tiled, for Euclidean and cosine on 512/768/1536 only; anything else throws before allocation. GramPlan applies RD15 precedence, Int32/overflow checks and the payload formula (planner = formula = observed in 76/76). It has cancellation checkpoints, drainWorstFirst, RD16 ties, and the RD1 bound with its domain hypothesis plus an overflow NaN test. The BLAS integers come from the plan's checked fields (C-M3). RD9 MatrixDistance refactor: bit-identical (sha 73ecf59b).
disposition_records.P02-PAIRWISE-PER-ROW: gemmPairwiseTyped prepares once and runs per row into the final row, with no N x N temporary (requested bytes fell in 18/18 cases). It is slower on one host (1.6-8.7x), which is disclosed. R03 is migrated. Euclidean GEMM pairwise is NOT bitwise symmetric (the doc was corrected, O-1).
disposition_records.P02-ARRAY-CAST-CLASS: 39 conditional array casts became exactArray, with a token-diff proof that only the expressions changed; all 39 guards are ahead. test_no_array_conditional_casts has an EMPTY allowlist and covers pattern, parenthesized, interpolated and backtick forms; typealias targets are a fixture-pinned limit. One fewer 16N+32 request per call in 54/54 cases.
disposition_records.P02-SCALARCOUNT-LAYOUT: scalarCount is computed on the four Vector*Optimized types: the handle stride goes 16 to 8, Mirror changes, and the JSON and B01 golden bytes are unchanged (encodeBinary reads scalarCount, whose computed value equals the old stored one).
disposition_records.P02-LEXER-GUARD-CLASS: Shared swift_lexing: opt-in interpolation keeping, _unbacktick, a raw-string quote fix, and test_swift_lexing. C2 counts every gramBatch token; C7 pins the pairwise shape; C8 pins the GemmArguments order and the single blas binding. The blast radius on both trees showed 0 new hits with the shipped lexer; the keep-by-default exploration routed to T17.
